Watch: Keep a very close eye on your leveraged positions and their stops. Also, monitor how the broader market's 'green' sentiment reconciles with the specific negative news for tech and AI.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your deeply underwater, leveraged tech positions.
